usage: brigade run cloud grokbot pack setup [-h] [--target TARGET] --id
                                            {implementation-worker,operator,repository-scout,dot,duet,operations-relay}
                                            [--json] [--bind BIND]
                                            [--allow-host ALLOW_HOST]
                                            [--allow-origin ALLOW_ORIGIN]
                                            [--bearer-file BEARER_FILE | --bearer-env BEARER_ENV]
                                            [--runtime-path RUNTIME_PATH]
                                            [--owner OWNER_WORKSPACE]
                                            [--apply]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target TARGET
  --id {implementation-worker,operator,repository-scout,dot,duet,operations-relay}
  --json
  --bind BIND           Listener host:port. Defaults to the pack loopback
                        port.
  --allow-host ALLOW_HOST
                        Explicit allowed Host value.
  --allow-origin ALLOW_ORIGIN
                        Explicit allowed Origin value.
  --bearer-file BEARER_FILE
                        Path of a protected bearer file (reference only).
  --bearer-env BEARER_ENV
                        Name of the environment variable holding the bearer.
  --runtime-path RUNTIME_PATH
                        Absolute runtime JSON path. Required for dot and duet.
  --owner OWNER_WORKSPACE
                        Absolute owner workspace. Required for operations-
                        relay.
  --apply               Write local config. Default is preview only.
